name: html
description: Write, analyze and validate semantic, accessible HTML. Use for .html files, templates, and markup structure/accessibility questions.
summary: Semantic, accessible, valid markup.
checklist: Landmark elements and headings are semantic
Images have alt text; form inputs have labels
pitfalls: Div soup instead of semantic elements

name: css
description: Write and debug modern CSS: layout (flexbox/grid), responsive design, custom properties, specificity. Use for .css files and styling/layout issues.
summary: Predictable layout with modern CSS, minimal specificity wars.
checklist: Responsive via relative units and media/container queries

name: scss-sass
description: Author SCSS/Sass with variables, mixins, nesting and partials that compile to clean CSS. Use for .scss/.sass files.
summary: Structured, DRY stylesheets that compile predictably.
checklist: No compiled-CSS committed if built in CI

name: javascript
description: Write, lint, format, test and debug modern JavaScript (ES2020+), Node and browser. Use for .js/.mjs/.cjs files and package.json projects.
summary: Modern, linted, tested JS with no needless transpilation.

name: typescript
description: Write and type-check TypeScript with strict types, generics and inference. Use for .ts files, tsconfig.json projects, and type errors.
summary: Strong types that catch bugs at compile time, not runtime.
checklist: strict mode on; no implicit any
No unsafe casts hiding real type errors
pitfalls: Using any/as to silence real errors
Trusting types at runtime boundaries instead of validating input

name: jsx-tsx
description: Work with JSX/TSX syntax used by React and similar libraries: components, props, hooks rules at the syntax level. Use for .jsx/.tsx files.
summary: Correct JSX/TSX: keys, hook rules, controlled inputs.
checklist: Hooks called unconditionally at top level
pitfalls: Conditional hooks breaking rules of hooks

name: php
description: Write, lint, analyze and test PHP (8+). Use for .php files, composer.json projects, Laravel/Symfony code.
summary: Typed, PSR-compliant, statically analyzed PHP.
checklist: No SQL built by string concatenation

name: webassembly
description: Build, inspect and debug WebAssembly modules and their JS/host bindings from Rust/C/AssemblyScript toolchains. Use for .wasm/.wat and wasm-pack projects.
summary: Compile to wasm and wire it to the host safely.
checklist: Memory boundaries between host and module respected
Bundle size and load path validated
pitfalls: Passing pointers without agreeing on memory layout

name: python
description: Write, lint, format, type-check, test and package Python 3. Use for .py files, pyproject.toml/requirements.txt projects, and Python errors.
summary: Typed, linted, tested Python in a clean virtual env.
checklist: Type hints on public functions; mypy clean
pitfalls: Installing into system Python instead of a venv
Catching Exception too broadly and hiding bugs

name: r-lang
description: Write and run R for statistics and data analysis, including tidyverse workflows. Use for .R/.Rmd files and RStudio projects. Detect Rscript before claiming support.
summary: Reproducible statistical analysis in R.
checklist: Analysis reproducible from a clean session
pitfalls: Relying on the global environment / hidden state

name: julia
description: Write and run Julia for numerical/scientific computing with its package manager and test suite. Use for .jl files and Project.toml. Detect the julia binary first.
summary: High-performance numerical code with typed multiple dispatch.
checklist: Benchmarks with BenchmarkTools, not @time in global scope

name: matlab
description: Read, write and reason about MATLAB/Octave numerical code. Use for .m files. Detect matlab or octave before claiming you can execute it.
summary: Matrix-oriented numerical code; run with MATLAB or GNU Octave if present.
checklist: Vectorized matrix ops over element loops

name: c
description: Write, compile, analyze and debug C with attention to memory safety and undefined behavior. Use for .c/.h files, Makefiles, and segfault/UB debugging.
summary: Portable C with warnings-as-errors, sanitizers and no UB.
checklist: Compiled with -Wall -Wextra and sanitizers in dev
All malloc paired with free; no leaks in valgrind

name: cpp
description: Write and review modern C++ (17/20): RAII, smart pointers, move semantics, templates, concurrency. Use for .cpp/.hpp files, CMake projects, and C++ build/UB issues.
summary: Modern C++ with RAII, no raw owning pointers, sanitizers on.
checklist: Ownership via RAII/smart pointers, not new/delete

name: rust
description: Write, lint, format, test and build Rust: ownership, borrowing, error handling, traits. Use for .rs files, Cargo.toml projects, and borrow-checker errors.
summary: Safe, idiomatic Rust with clippy clean and no needless unwrap.
checklist: No unwrap/expect on fallible paths in library code
pitfalls: Fighting the borrow checker by cloning everything

name: go
description: Write, vet, test and build idiomatic Go: goroutines, channels, explicit error handling, interfaces. Use for .go files and go.mod projects.
summary: Simple, idiomatic Go with vet clean and errors handled.

name: zig
description: Write and build Zig with explicit allocators, comptime and C interop. Use for .zig files and build.zig. Detect the zig binary before claiming support.
summary: Explicit, allocator-aware systems code with no hidden control flow.
pitfalls: Leaking because an allocator's free was skipped
Assuming a stable std API across Zig versions

name: nim
description: Write and compile Nim, a statically typed language compiling to C/JS. Use for .nim files and .nimble projects. Detect nim before claiming support.
summary: Expressive, compiled Nim with strong static typing.
checklist: Release vs debug flags set appropriately

name: d-lang
description: Write and build D language code with its compilers and dub package manager. Use for .d files and dub.json/dub.sdl. Detect dmd/ldc2 before claiming support.
summary: Systems-capable D with modern conveniences.
checklist: GC vs manual memory tradeoffs deliberate
pitfalls: Unexpected GC pauses in hot paths

name: lua
description: Write and debug Lua for scripting and embedding (LOVE, Neovim, game hosts). Use for .lua files. Detect lua/luajit before executing.
summary: Small, embeddable scripting with careful global hygiene.
checklist: Locals used instead of accidental globals

name: perl
description: Read, write and modernize Perl 5 scripts with strict/warnings and testing. Use for .pl/.pm files. Detect perl before executing.
summary: Maintainable Perl with strict, warnings and tests.
checklist: Tests under t/ pass with prove

name: ruby
description: Write, lint, format and test Ruby (and Rails) code. Use for .rb files, Gemfile projects, and RSpec/Minitest suites.
summary: Idiomatic, RuboCop-clean, well-tested Ruby.
